request: How large is the immigration court backlog and how has it changed over time?

reply.reply:
At the end of FY2024, EOIR had **3,558,995 pending immigration court cases** (CRS IN12492, PDF p. 4). Historically, pending **I-862 cases** grew about six-fold from FY2008 to FY2020, reaching more than 1.2 million in FY2020 (CRS IF11690, PDF p. 1). The historical comparison is specifically for I-862 cases, while the FY2024 figure is the overall pending-case count.

See the [brief](output/briefs/case-20261021-163749-b515.html) for details.
